facts.summary: Durability disappointing, lower CR in newer patients · Phase 2 pivotal · detalimogene voraplasmid in BCG-unresponsive NMIBC · not yet approved
facts.indication: BCG-unresponsive non-muscle invasive bladder cancer with carcinoma in situ

evidence.summary: While durability outcomes to date are not what we hoped, these data are preliminary.
evidence.safety: Six patients experienced Grade ≥3 TRAEs, including one Grade 4 TRAE, which has resolved. There were no Grade 5 TRAEs reported.
